To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the temperature behavior of the system is affected by both its jobs characteristics and scheduling strategy.

we propose a novel analytical method for thermal analysis of real-time systems with probabilistic execution time and we demonstrate that the proposed method can be used to analyze the reliability and power consumption behavior of individual tasks in a system with periodic tasks.

the thermal analysis of periodic real time systems with stochastic properties could be performed by an analytical method that extracts a fundamental temperature measure to represent thermal specification.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions.
the development of analytical tools for thermal specification of real-time systems and the use of this specification in performance analysis of the system.
thermal-aware analysis and design of real-time systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented method could be used by system designers to perform a complete temperature-aware analysis of a periodic real-time system with stochastic properties.
this method provides a powerful and accurate tool for temperature-aware analysis of periodic real- time systems with stochastic properties.

our method is able to capture and analyze the stochastic thermal behavior of real-time systems and, therefore, it could be used as a design and analysis tool to improve the performance, reliability, and power consumption of real-time systems with periodic tasks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have presented the first method to analyze the thermal behavior of real-time systems with probabilistic properties.
we provide an analytical method to model thermal behavior of real-time systems and use this model for temperature-aware analysis of system performance.

we have presented a novel method to analyze thermal behavior of a real-time periodic system with stochastic properties and we have shown how this analysis could be used to perform temperature-aware reliability and power consumption analysis of individual tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
temperature probability density function is an important measure for thermal specification of periodic real-time system with probabilistic execution time.
the designer can use the temperature probability density function as a fundamental specification to perform a wide range of temperature-aware performance analysis of the system.

the proposed analytical approach can be used to extract thermal specification for a given task set and scheduling algorithm, and then use this specification to analyze reliability and power consumption for any arbitrary task set with the same scheduling algorithm.
